title: Seed keyed-mode record whose single-field key is authored as an empty array keys empty and is inserted on every load
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaysxGzF62ACvZ1x9x

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding (class b, named producer): seat L2 on PR #35459 (#34857 + #35336), record 7007796559, nit N3. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:server` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`). Suggested-grade: p3 · one line in the blank helper. Parent: #34857.
Dedupe: `isBlankSeedKeyValue empty array` in open issues: none.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：极少见的写法（把唯一标识写成空列表）目前仍会每次加载都多插一条；修好后会像留空一样被拒收并说明原因。
- 为什么做：刚上线的"标识留空就拒收"规则漏了这一种写法。
- 出错会怎样：现有示例数据都不这样写；影响仅限这种写法的作者。
- 要你做什么：无（分诊定级）。

## What happens

After PR #35459, `isBlankSeedKeyValue` treats no value, `null` and `''` as blank. The single-field arm of `externalIdKey` is `String(record[externalId] ?? '')`, which is also `''` for `[]`, so a record whose single key field is authored `[]` keys empty, is not refused, and is inserted on every load. Not reachable from any stock dataset.

## Expected

A value that keys empty is blank for the refusal too (one rule: blank exactly when the key string is empty), pinned with a three-load `[]` case. If this widens the refusal it is a narrowing: carry the declaration and, if the gate asks, extend the existing ADR-0087 entry rather than adding one.
